$comment: Baselines for `buddy lint:stx`. A number here is a DEBT, not a target.
The gate fails if a count goes above its baseline, and also if a count drops
below one without the baseline being lowered - a ratchet that only ever
loosens is theatre. Run `./buddy lint:stx --update` in the same diff as the
change that clears violations, never on its own.
Every non-zero entry names what clears it:
stx-config-keys       3 - config/ui.ts sets no strict/root/pagesDir. Pinning
root+pagesDir changes stx topology resolution, so
it needs a dev+build pass, not a blind edit.
doctype-no-nolayout   5 - marketing/desktop shells still own their DOCTYPE;
blocked on stacksjs/stx#1798 (generateDocumentShell
htmlAttrs), without which removing the shell drops
the class the landing-page tokens are scoped to.
style-block           2 - two templates still carry a <style> block; the
destination is config/crosswind.ts preflights.
dom-guard             3 - coming-soon.stx and index.stx are still imperative.
inline-style-attr    49 - mostly the desktop demo components, plus pre-hydration
display:none, whose sanctioned form is a :class with
literal branches.
plain-internal-anchor 4 - four <a href="/"> on the marketing pages; use StxLink.
